purpose: Portfolio synthesis context for evaluating Super Bowl Winner exposure and team-season liability. This is not a betting instruction.

promotion.name: Super Bowl Futures Special - Win $10 Every Week

eligible_market.label: Super Bowl 2027 LXI Winner futures odds

promotion.qualifying_wager_note: Only the first real-money BetOnline Super Bowl Winner wager of $50 or more during the qualifying period is eligible. Bets under $50 do not qualify.
eligible_candidate_teams: any BetOnline Super Bowl Winner selection

reward.credit_timing: By 7:00 pm ET on the Wednesday after each week in which the selected team wins.

portfolio_modeling.cash_equivalent_note: Free-bet credits are not cash and stake is not returned, so the model should haircut nominal value when estimating EV or liability offset.
portfolio_modeling.liability_note: Use the selected team's win distribution to estimate expected weekly free-bet credits and downside/upside exposure. Because the offer can be used once, choosing Packers/Bills/Ravens consumes the option for all other teams.

terms_summary: BetOnline account must be in good standing with at least one lifetime deposit.
Place a real-money wager of $50 or more on Super Bowl 2027 LXI Winner futures odds between 2026-07-17 12:00 am ET and 2026-09-11 11:59 pm ET.
Only one promotion per account, and only the first qualifying $50+ Super Bowl Winner wager during the promotional period qualifies.
Each regular-season win by the selected team earns a $10 Free Bet credited the following Wednesday by 7:00 pm ET.
Reward must be claimed from account notifications within 30 days.
Free Bet credits require one-time wagering before withdrawal eligibility; the Free Bet risk amount is not included in returns or winnings.
Free Bet credits are non-transferable, not redeemable for cash, and expire in 30 days unless otherwise stated.
BetOnline may alter or amend terms without notice; BetOnline general rules also apply.
